N1.s: Masz już komplet %lld darmowych cutlingów. Ten zapisze się, gdy przejdziesz do aplikacji i ją odblokujesz.
N1.back: You-have already full-set of-5 free cutlings. This-one will-save itself, when you-go-over to application and it you-will-unlock.
N1.why: Opens with S3's 'Masz już komplet' so the limit reads the same everywhere; 'Ten zapisze się' promises the item saves itself after unlocking, and 'ją' points at the app, so the name is not repeated or declined.

N2.s: Masz już komplet %lld darmowych cutlingów. Otwórz Cutling i odblokuj go, by zapisać więcej.
N2.back: You-have already full-set of-5 free cutlings. Open Cutling and unlock it, so-as to-save more.
N2.why: Same first sentence as N1; here nothing can continue in the app, so the second is a plain ty-form instruction, with the name in the inanimate accusative (same as nominative) and no promise that this item was kept.

N3.why: Impersonal 'Zapisano' has no gender; 'Został jeden darmowy' is how a Pole says one is left, with 'cutling' understood as in K1; no closing period, like K1's capsule; exactly 30.

N4.why: 'Komplet' is the word S3 uses for all five used, and the count pair matches S5 and S29; 29 characters.

N5.s: Masz %lld z %lld. Odblokuj, a ten się zapisze
N5.back: You-have 5 of 5. Unlock, and this-one itself will-save
N5.why: The count says full without a limit word; 'a ten się zapisze' tells the person the text they were saving is not lost; 39 of 40.

N6.why: The same button verb as S15, sitting where 'Zapisz' would be.

N7.s: Masz już komplet %lld darmowych cutlingów. Ten zapisze się, gdy odblokujesz Cutling.
N7.back: You-have already full-set of-5 free cutlings. This-one will-save itself, when you-unlock Cutling.
N7.why: 'Ten' opens the second sentence so it plainly means the item in the form, not the app named at its end; same shape as N1 so Shortcut and Share say one thing.

N8.s: Ten cutling poczeka. Zapisze się, gdy otworzysz Cutling i go odblokujesz.
N8.back: This cutling will-wait. It-will-save itself, when you-open Cutling and it you-will-unlock.
N8.why: 'poczeka' says it was kept the way a person would, with no 'we' and no passive; the subject of 'Zapisze się' carries over from the first sentence, so 'go' can only be the app.
